spaceBunnyDisposition.finding: Protocol-error path mutates an already-failed framer

spaceBunnyDisposition.finding: Status coupling and prior completion observation loss

spaceBunnyDisposition.decision: Added exact/default byte limits, one-byte excess, pending buffer oversized chunk and framing/protocol failure reason assertions before final recording.

spaceBunnyDisposition.decision: Rejected. Only one empty entry exists; task outcome intentionally unproven; captured schema absence must fail verification rather than skip.

spaceBunnyDisposition.decision: README explicitly identifies local limits, state transitions, no native transport and no provider qualification.
